endotracheal tube tip approximately 4 cm above the carina. A line

the bilateral chest regions. Bilateral lungs are otherwise clear
without focal consolidation. Blunting of the left costophrenic
angle may reflect small pleural effusion or pleural thickening.

changes are seen in the bilateral acromioclavicular and
glenohumeral joints.

PLEURAL EFFUSION OR PLEURAL THICKENING.
